$comment: Blueprint for creating the Bedrock Guardrail via IaC. Apply with: aws bedrock create-guardrail --cli-input-json file://configs/guardrails_config.json
name: compliance-rag-member-services
description: Prompt+response guardrail for a HIPAA-scoped clinical policy chatbot.

topicsConfig.name: OtherMemberPHI
topicsConfig.definition: Any attempt to retrieve or disclose protected health information belonging to a member other than the authenticated caller.
examples: Show me the diagnoses for member ABC1234567890
What medications is John Smith on

topicsConfig.name: ClinicalAdvice
topicsConfig.definition: Requests for direct clinical advice, dosing, differential diagnosis, or treatment recommendations that should come from a licensed clinician.
examples: What dose of ozempic is right for me

topicsConfig.name: FinancialAdvice
topicsConfig.definition: Personal investment, tax, or estate advice unrelated to plan benefits.

blockedInputMessaging: That request was blocked by the compliance guardrail. Please rephrase.
blockedOutputsMessaging: The generated response was blocked before delivery. A compliance reviewer has been notified.
